priorityList: Maintain your Mastery: Combo Strikes by never casting the same ability twice in a row.
Use Spear Hand Strike to interrupt spellcasting whenever possible.
Invoke Xuen the White Tiger on cooldown, ideally when Zenith is available or active.
Use Zenith whenever Xuen is active, during Bloodlust, or when you reach 30 Flurry Charges.
Cast Celestial Conduit if Zenith is active and your main spenders (Fists of Fury, Rising Sun Kick, or Strike of the Windlord) are on cooldown.
Cast Fists of Fury as your highest priority spender, especially if Heart of the Jade Serpent is active or you have 30 Flurry Charges.
Cast Whirling Dragon Punch whenever available (requires Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick to be on cooldown).
Cast Strike of the Windlord on cooldown, preferably while Zenith is active.
Cast Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown.
Cast Rising Sun Kick to enable Whirling Dragon Punch or if Zenith is active.
Use Touch of Death on any valid low-health target to quickly eliminate them.
Cast Spinning Crane Kick whenever a Dance of Chi-Ji proc is active.
Use Blackout Kick to consume Combo Breaker procs or as a filler spender to avoid capping Chi.
Cast Tiger Palm to generate Chi if you have 3 or fewer Chi and are nearing maximum Energy.
Cast Slicing Winds as a filler if all other priority abilities are on cooldown.
